2026-08-16 LOCAL: PUBLISHED GEOMETRY — CHIP_METRICS / chipSize / ChipGeometry, the group's own pattern applied to this component because the DS ships none for it and keeps its measure()/linesOf() module-private (#97). A board that lays out arithmetically has to predict a chip's box before it renders, and AuthorRoad was guessing it: CHAR_W = 8 for a proportional face, chrome scored at 40 when it is really ~83, so every title the estimate scored as one line wrapped to two and was cropped by the shell's overflow:hidden against the height it had been TOLD. Two rules make the fix hold, both taken from the group's geometry: CSS OWNS WHAT CSS DECLARES (--stroke-rule, --lh-snug, --fs-body, --fs-micro and the weights are read from the stylesheet at measure time, never copied), and THE TABLE OWNS WHAT JS DECLARES — the RENDERER now reads CHIP_METRICS back for its gap, paddings, dot, index lift, title gutter and delete box, so a change lands in the drawing and in the prediction together or not at all. Text is canvas-measured at the chip's own font; fontOf/measure/linesOf are this file's own copies of the group's rather than a shared import, matching the DS's own call on useRecede/useSizeDrag. `maxHeight` is spent on LINES rather than cropped to, so the box returned always matches the lines actually drawn. PROVEN by tools/studio-spike/shot-foldab.mjs, which renders the chip both TOLD the predicted box (which must hold its text — zero overflow past the shell) and NATURAL (sizing itself inside the road's bound), over the titles that clipped on the board: told box exact, lines exact, title column within 1px and on the safe side — the canvas runs ~0.99px OVER the laid-out width of the mono step number, constant rather than per-character, so it under-claims the column and can only ever buy a line, never crop one. To report on #74: the DS should own this, as it already does for the group.
